T: Same thing happens to the same guy twice.
D: John McClane fights terrorists who've taken over a snowed-in Washington airport on Christmas Eve.
P: Serve dinner while Holly's plane circles overhead, running out of fuel.
S: the snack bar at Dulles on Christmas Eve
Buttermilk biscuits split warm and filled with thin slices of salty ham and a smear of mustard butter.
the bar where he spots the bad guys
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, blue cheese dip and celery.
Bake small potatoes, halve, scoop, brush with butter, crisp at 220C, fill with cheddar and bacon, bake again, sour cream and chives.
M: Virginia barbecue, eaten standing up between fights
Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow cooked until it pulls apart, tossed in vinegar sauce, piled into soft rolls with slaw.
for everyone stuck at the gate
Beef chuck and mince browned, braised 2.5 hours with onion, chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans. Sour cream and cheddar.
W: Gingerbread dough (butter, brown sugar, golden syrup, ginger, cinnamon) rolled, cut into planes and snowflakes, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, iced.
K: McClane's one drink before it all kicks off
American lager on tap, poured cold into a pint glass.

s.note: the snack bar at Dulles on Christmas Eve
s.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour with 1 tsp salt, stir in 200ml buttermilk and pat 2cm thick. Cut 12 rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Split warm, spread with 40g butter mixed with 1 tbsp Dijon and fill with 200g thin-sliced leg ham.

Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush with 40g butter. Crisp at 220C for 10 minutes, fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake 5 more minutes. Top with sour cream and chives.

m.note: for everyone stuck at the gate
m.how: Brown 600g diced beef chuck and 400g mince. Add 1 onion, 2 tbsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin, then 2 tins tomatoes. Braise 2.5 hours, adding 2 tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.

w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp bicarb. Chill an hour, roll and cut into planes and snowflakes. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and ice with 200g icing sugar.

d.note: McClane's one drink before it all kicks off
d.how: Chill 2L of American lager in bottles or cans for at least three hours. Pour into four pint glasses, tilted at first, then straight to build a small head, like the bar at the airport.
